scenarios.name: Apprentice Electrician Summer Gear Under $250
scenarios.description: User specifies occupation (apprentice electrician), item slots (summer pants and composite-toe boots), and budget ($250). Engine must decompose slots, search catalog independently, and ensure bundle price <= $250 AUD.
scenarios.prompt: I’m an apprentice electrician. I need lightweight summer pants and composite-toe boots under $250.

assertions.description: Required item slots (pants, boots) must be decomposed
Total bundle cost must be <= $250 AUD (25000 cents)
Every SKU in recommended bundle must exist in WWG catalog
